model_interpretation.claim: The selected SSE2 parent was correct at 5.631 ms versus the 7.529 ms baseline, but it retains per-lane logf and expf calls. This experiment replaces those calls in the guarded four-option SSE2 path with range-reduced vector approximations, retaining the supplied Black-Scholes computation and CND coefficients and falling back to the scalar loop for unsafe blocks and tails.
